headlines.title: GM wants drivers to be able to text and drive
headlines.summary: Mary Barra says GM is making “leaps and bounds” toward eyes-off driving, with the first system due on the 2028 Cadillac Escalade IQ.

headlines.title: Why the Market Dipped But General Motors (GM) Gained Today
headlines.summary: General Motors (GM) closed at $84 in the latest trading session, marking a +1.98% move from the prior day.

headlines.title: GM’s 2028 “Eyes-Off” Driving Plan Might Change The Case For Investing In General Motors (GM)
headlines.summary: In recent days, General Motors CEO Mary Barra reaffirmed that GM remains on track to roll out "eyes-off, hands-off" driving technology by 2028, starting with the electric Cadillac Escalade IQ and expanding to consumer-owned vehicles after exiting the Cruise robotaxi business.

headlines.title: General Motors (GM) Stock Looks 36% Undervalued On Cash Flow
headlines.summary: General Motors has ridden a powerful three year share price run while pushing deeper into electric vehicles and advanced driving technology. This puts fresh focus on whether the current US$82.37 stock price lines up with the cash the business is expected to generate over time. Over the past 3 years, General Motors has returned 182.4%, so a lot of future cash flow is already being treated as real by the market.

headlines.title: General Motors (GM) Plans 500 New Jobs At Tennessee Battery Plant
headlines.summary: General Motors (NYSE:GM) and LG are investing in next‑generation lithium manganese rich EV battery production at GM's Spring Hill, Tennessee complex. The new LMR battery project is planned at the existing Spring Hill site that already supports GM's electric vehicle manufacturing footprint. GM expects the partnership with LG at Spring Hill to create around 500 new jobs tied to advanced battery production.

description: General Motors Company designs, builds, and sells trucks, crossovers, cars, and automobile parts worldwide. It operates through GM North America, GM International, and GM Financial segments. The company markets its vehicles primarily under the Buick, Cadillac, Chevrolet, GMC, Baojun, and Wuling brand names. In addition, it sells trucks, crossovers, cars, and automobile parts through retail dealers, distributors and dealers, as well as to fleet customers, including daily rental car companies, commercial fleet customers, leasing companies, and governments. Further, the company offers various range of after-sale services through dealer network, such as maintenance, light repairs, collision repairs, vehicle accessories, and extended service warranties. Additionally, it provides automotive financing; and software-enabled services and subscriptions. General Motors Company was founded in 1908 and is based in Detroit, Michigan.
